title: LiAngelo Ball Accused of Cheating on Nikki Mudarris & Leaving Their Family
htmlContent:
Nikki Mudarris, who is famous for her role on reality TV, has filed accusations against her longtime partner, LiAngelo Ball, regarding infidelity and abandoning their family. On social media, the Love & Hip-Hop: Hollywood anthem made shocking allegations and revealed heartrending details about their split after more than three years together.

Nikki Mudarris Calls Out LiAngelo Ball for Cheating

Mudarris, 34, took to Instagram on February 8th to share her perspective on the story. According to her, Ball's alleged infidelity was reported to her by multiple sources. It was reported that the 26-year-old basketball player-turned-rapper, who had previously impregnated another woman, departed with Mudarris and his two young children, son LaVelo and daughter LaNiyah, after revealing that he had impregnated another woman.

He Walked Out on His Kids and Me

Mudarris wrote a moving post that expressed her pain and disbelief, saying, “I am just as surprised as you are. We spent 3 1/2 years together, and last week he decided to walk out on his kids and me.” She described the situation as the “ultimate betrayal,” they had recently planned a family photoshoot before Ball's shocking revelation. She continued by writing,

“My daughter is not even 2 months old, and dealing with this along with postpartum is very hard. Please pray for me & my healing because I will get through this.”

"Mudarris Speaks on the "Ultimate Betrayal" The former reality star was not afraid to speak out, claiming that Ball had admitted to fathering another child with an unnamed woman. Mudarris revealed that the woman he left for is older than she is. She called out Ball's method of breaking the news, stating that he told her about the pregnancy via text message, which she called 'cowardly and pathetic'.

Moving Forward for Her Kids

Despite her emotional turmoil, Mudarris stressed the importance of staying focused on her children.

“Anyways, back to my KIDS. That’s all that matters. I’m done giving this s--- my attention,” she wrote in her Instagram Stories.

Mudarris was quickly surrounded by her supporters, who offered her support and encouragement. Her struggles were felt by many, particularly as she faced postpartum challenges while dealing with the public breakup.

LiAngelo Ball Remains Silent

LiAngelo Ball has not addressed the allegations publicly. Their relationship was initially kept private, but Mudarris revealed in an interview with Sheen Magazine that they met while walking their dogs at Runyon Canyon.

A Painful Chapter in Mudarris’ Life

Mudarris' social media posts reveal the pain of an unexpected breakup, particularly one involving children. While navigating her emotions, the reality star has clarified that her children are her top priority. As she moves forward from this challenging chapter, fans support her. Many are waiting to see if Ball will respond to the allegations or remain silent since there has been no response.
